Build succeeds. Here's a summary of all changes made:

**`SerializationApp.csproj`** — TFM `net8.0` → `net9.0`, added `<ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>`

**`NullDocHandler.cs`** — `JsonSerializer.Deserialize<JsonDocument>("null")` [no longer returns `null` in .NET 9](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/compatibility/serialization/9.0/deserialize-jsondocument); it returns a `JsonDocument` with `RootElement.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Null`. Updated the check accordingly and added `Dispose()` for the non-null document.
